summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Silynxcom Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release announcing its full-year 2025 financial results and a business update for early 2026. The filing reports revenues of $5.8 million, a net cash position, and a $7.3 million backlog. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release and business update, not a special situation.
